name: ProductionScheduleSequencer
tagline: Drag-and-drop line sequencing with a changeover matrix, shift capacity and due-date risk.
description: A finite, changeover-aware sequencing board for Power Apps and Power Pages. Planners drag released production orders between lines and slots, see changeover minutes, shift load and late/at-risk orders recalculate instantly, auto-sequence by changeover or due date, lock running jobs and release the agreed sequence to the floor.
features: Finite schedule from shifts, breaks, working days and line speed
Sequence-dependent changeover matrix with heat map
Late / at-risk / beyond-horizon flags with KPI deltas
Drag and drop on timeline and list, between lines and backlog
Auto-sequence: balanced, minimise changeover, earliest due date
Line qualification, locks, undo, reset and release with blocking checks
